evals.name: api-service-test
evals.prompt: I need to write tests for a patients API module. It has a function called fetchPatients that calls GET /api/patients and returns an array of patients. I want tests that cover: successful response with data, empty response, network error, and an unauthorized (401) response. Use fetch mocking.
evals.expected_output: A test file with describe/fetchPatients, it blocks for success/empty/error/401, using vi.fn() mock of global.fetch, with beforeEach reset.

assertions.name: has-success-test
assertions.description: Tests the successful response path with patient data

assertions.name: has-empty-test
assertions.description: Tests that empty array is handled (not an error)

assertions.name: has-network-error-test
assertions.description: Tests that fetch rejection (network error) throws or returns error

assertions.name: has-401-test
assertions.description: Tests that 401 response is handled (throws or returns error)

assertions.name: uses-vi-fn
assertions.description: Uses vi.fn() for mocking fetch

assertions.name: has-beforeEach-reset
assertions.description: Resets mocks in beforeEach

assertions.name: collocation-path
assertions.description: Test file is named patients.api.test.ts alongside the source

evals.name: zustand-store-tdd
evals.prompt: I want to build a shopping cart store with Zustand. It should have: items array, addItem action, removeItem action, clearCart action, and a computed total. Write the tests FIRST (TDD: RED phase), then I'll implement the store.
evals.expected_output: A test file with describe blocks for addItem, removeItem, clearCart, and total. Tests written before the store exists, describing the expected behavior.

assertions.name: tdd-test-before-implementation
assertions.description: Tests reference expected store shape even though it doesn't exist yet

assertions.name: has-add-item-test
assertions.description: Tests that addItem adds to the items array

assertions.name: has-remove-item-test
assertions.description: Tests that removeItem removes by id

assertions.name: has-clear-cart-test
assertions.description: Tests that clearCart empties items and resets total

assertions.name: has-total-calculation
assertions.description: Tests that total = sum of (item.price * item.quantity)

assertions.name: has-beforeEach-reset
assertions.description: Resets store state in beforeEach

assertions.name: uses-act
assertions.description: Wraps store mutations in act() for hook-based test or uses getState() for direct store test

evals.name: hook-with-query-test
evals.prompt: I have a custom hook called usePatientDetail that takes a patient ID, calls fetchPatientDetail via TanStack Query, and returns { patient, isLoading, error }. Write tests for: loading state, successful response, error response, and the hook using the correct queryKey. The API module should be mocked.
evals.expected_output: A test file using renderHook with a QueryClientProvider wrapper, testing loading/success/error states with waitFor.

assertions.name: uses-render-hook
assertions.description: Uses renderHook from @testing-library/react-native

assertions.name: has-query-wrapper
assertions.description: Wraps hook in QueryClientProvider with retry: false

assertions.name: tests-loading-state
assertions.description: Checks that isLoading is true initially

assertions.name: tests-success-state
assertions.description: Waits for data and asserts patient is returned

assertions.name: tests-error-state
assertions.description: Mocks rejection and asserts error is set

assertions.name: mocks-api-module
assertions.description: Mocks the API module with vi.mock, not global.fetch

assertions.name: uses-wait-for
assertions.description: Uses waitFor for async assertions instead of arbitrary timeouts
